slots.title: Warsh: rates vs the AI spend wave
slots.body:
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said higher interest rates are reaching the investment surge, and that growth is broadening beyond it.

That framing lands the day before a heavy data morning: Q3 GDP (estimate +3.2% QoQ vs +2.2% prior) and September PCE inflation at 12:30 p.m.
ET.

The 10-year Treasury yield sat at 5.0% on the latest FMP snapshot (Oct. 27).

The 2-year/10-year spread was 0.29 percentage point.

Does policy follow the capex-heavy growth story or the broader economy — where do you draw the line?
